source.body: {"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE wm_tech_card SET steps_json = CAST(? AS text) WHERE id = CAST(? AS varchar)", "params": ["${input.stepsJson}", "${input.cardId}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "id": "${input.cardId}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wm_ticket (id, plant_id, equipment_id, shop_id, title, description, severity, status, source, created_by, assignee, created_at) SELECT 'tk-' || substr(md5(random()::text),1,8), 'plant-zgpd', CAST(? AS varchar), (SELECT shop_id FROM wm_equipment WHERE id = CAST(? AS varchar)), CAST(? AS varchar), CAST(? AS varchar), CAST(? AS varchar), 'new', 'hmi', CAST(? AS varchar), 'Федоров П.И.', NOW()", "params": ["${input.equipmentId}", "${input.equipmentId}", "${input.title}", "${input.description}", "${input.severity}", "${input.createdBy}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO wm_audit_log (id, plant_id, entity_type, entity_id, action, detail, actor, created_at) SELECT 'au-' || substr(md5(random()::text),1,8), 'plant-zgpd', 'ticket', CAST(? AS varchar), 'created', CAST(? AS varchar), CAST(? AS varchar), NOW()", "params": ["${input.equipmentId}", "${input.title}", "${input.createdBy}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "id": "${input.equipmentId}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT e.*, s.code AS shop_code, s.name AS shop_name FROM wm_equipment e JOIN wm_shop s ON s.id = e.shop_id WHERE e.id = ?) t", "params": ["${input.equipmentId}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT key, value FROM wm_kpi ORDER BY key) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, code, name, status, health_index AS \"healthIndex\", chamber_temp_c AS \"chamberTempC\", air_humidity_pct AS \"airHumidityPct\", wood_moisture_pct AS \"woodMoisturePct\", cycle_stage AS \"cycleStage\", cycle_eta_min AS \"cycleEtaMin\", fan_ok AS \"fanOk\", heater_ok AS \"heaterOk\", mode_deviation AS \"modeDeviation\" FROM wm_equipment WHERE eq_type = 'dryer' ORDER BY code) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT b.id, b.batch_no AS \"batchNo\", b.species, b.thickness_mm AS \"thicknessMm\", b.moisture_in_pct AS \"moistureInPct\", b.moisture_out_pct AS \"moistureOutPct\", b.target_moisture_pct AS \"targetMoisturePct\", b.duration_h AS \"durationH\", b.max_temp_c AS \"maxTempC\", b.status, b.deviations, e.code AS \"chamberCode\", b.started_at AS \"startedAt\", b.finished_at AS \"finishedAt\" FROM wm_drying_batch b JOIN wm_equipment e ON e.id = b.chamber_id ORDER BY b.started_at DESC NULLS LAST) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT e.id, e.code, e.name, e.eq_type AS \"eqType\", e.status, e.health_index AS \"healthIndex\", e.link_ok AS \"linkOk\", e.shop_id AS \"shopId\", s.code AS \"shopCode\", s.name AS \"shopName\", e.feed_mpm AS \"feedMpm\", e.power_kw AS \"powerKw\", e.current_a AS \"currentA\", e.bearing_temp_c AS \"bearingTempC\", e.vibration_mms AS \"vibrationMms\", e.tool_state AS \"toolState\", e.volume_m3 AS \"volumeM3\", e.stop_count AS \"stopCount\", e.spindle_rpm AS \"spindleRpm\", e.load_pct AS \"loadPct\", e.tool_wear_pct AS \"toolWearPct\", e.vacuum_bar AS \"vacuumBar\", e.chamber_temp_c AS \"chamberTempC\", e.air_humidity_pct AS \"airHumidityPct\", e.wood_moisture_pct AS \"woodMoisturePct\", e.cycle_stage AS \"cycleStage\", e.cycle_eta_min AS \"cycleEtaMin\", e.fan_ok AS \"fanOk\", e.heater_ok AS \"heaterOk\", e.mode_deviation AS \"modeDeviation\", e.press_mpa AS \"pressMpa\", e.glue_gm2 AS \"glueGm2\", e.hold_min AS \"holdMin\", e.coat_temp_c AS \"coatTempC\", e.operator_name AS \"operatorName\", e.runtime_hours AS \"runtimeHours\" FROM wm_equipment e JOIN wm_shop s ON s.id = e.shop_id WHERE e.plant_id = 'plant-zgpd' ORDER BY s.sort_order, e.code) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT e.id, e.code, e.name, e.eq_type AS \"eqType\", e.status, e.health_index AS \"healthIndex\", e.link_ok AS \"linkOk\", e.feed_mpm AS \"feedMpm\", e.power_kw AS \"powerKw\", e.current_a AS \"currentA\", e.bearing_temp_c AS \"bearingTempC\", e.vibration_mms AS \"vibrationMms\", e.tool_state AS \"toolState\", e.volume_m3 AS \"volumeM3\", e.stop_count AS \"stopCount\", e.chamber_temp_c AS \"chamberTempC\", e.wood_moisture_pct AS \"woodMoisturePct\", e.cycle_stage AS \"cycleStage\", e.cycle_eta_min AS \"cycleEtaMin\", e.mode_deviation AS \"modeDeviation\", e.fan_ok AS \"fanOk\", e.heater_ok AS \"heaterOk\", e.tool_wear_pct AS \"toolWearPct\", e.vacuum_bar AS \"vacuumBar\", e.spindle_rpm AS \"spindleRpm\", e.load_pct AS \"loadPct\", e.press_mpa AS \"pressMpa\", e.operator_name AS \"operatorName\" FROM wm_equipment e WHERE e.shop_id = ? ORDER BY e.code) t", "params": ["${input.shopId}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT e.code, e.name, e.eq_type AS \"eqType\", e.health_index AS \"healthIndex\", e.status, s.code AS \"shopCode\", e.bearing_temp_c AS \"bearingTempC\", e.vibration_mms AS \"vibrationMms\", e.current_a AS \"currentA\", e.stop_count AS \"stopCount\", e.tool_wear_pct AS \"toolWearPct\", e.runtime_hours AS \"runtimeHours\", e.last_service_at AS \"lastServiceAt\" FROM wm_equipment e JOIN wm_shop s ON s.id = e.shop_id ORDER BY e.health_index ASC, e.code) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, series, label, value, sort_order AS \"sortOrder\" FROM wm_kpi_point WHERE series = ? ORDER BY sort_order) t", "params": ["${input.series}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, equipment_id AS \"equipmentId\", param_key AS \"paramKey\", param_value AS \"paramValue\", recorded_at AS \"recordedAt\" FROM wm_param_history WHERE equipment_id = ? ORDER BY recorded_at) t", "params": ["${input.equipmentId}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT p.id, s.code AS \"shopCode\", s.name AS \"shopName\", p.shift_date AS \"shiftDate\", p.shift_code AS \"shiftCode\", p.product_name AS \"productName\", p.plan_m3 AS \"planM3\", p.fact_m3 AS \"factM3\", CASE WHEN p.plan_m3 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((p.fact_m3 * 100.0 / p.plan_m3)::numeric, 1) END AS \"planPct\", p.pieces, p.scrap_pct AS \"scrapPct\", p.status FROM wm_production_plan p JOIN wm_shop s ON s.id = p.shop_id ORDER BY s.sort_order) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT q.id, q.batch_no AS \"batchNo\", q.product_type AS \"productType\", q.thickness_mm AS \"thicknessMm\", q.thickness_dev_mm AS \"thicknessDevMm\", q.moisture_pct AS \"moisturePct\", q.flatness_mm AS \"flatnessMm\", q.glue_joint_ok AS \"glueJointOk\", q.defects, q.status, q.decision, q.inspector, q.checked_at AS \"checkedAt\", e.code AS \"equipmentCode\" FROM wm_quality_check q LEFT JOIN wm_equipment e ON e.id = q.equipment_id ORDER BY q.checked_at DESC) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, code, name, purpose, sort_order AS \"sortOrder\", plan_m3 AS \"planM3\", fact_m3 AS \"factM3\", CASE WHEN plan_m3 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((fact_m3 * 100.0 / plan_m3)::numeric, 1) END AS \"planPct\", scrap_pct AS \"scrapPct\", waste_m3 AS \"wasteM3\", downtime_min AS \"downtimeMin\", energy_kwh_m3 AS \"energyKwhM3\", status FROM wm_shop WHERE plant_id = 'plant-zgpd' ORDER BY sort_order) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, part_name AS \"partName\", order_no AS \"orderNo\", material, blank_size AS \"blankSize\", program_code AS \"programCode\", spindle_rpm AS \"spindleRpm\", feed_mpm AS \"feedMpm\", depth_mm AS \"depthMm\", tools, quality_req AS \"qualityReq\", steps_json AS \"stepsJson\", equipment_id AS \"equipmentId\" FROM wm_tech_card) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT t.id, t.title, t.description, t.severity, t.status, t.source, t.created_by AS \"createdBy\", t.assignee, t.root_cause AS \"rootCause\", t.created_at AS \"createdAt\", t.closed_at AS \"closedAt\", e.code AS \"equipmentCode\", s.code AS \"shopCode\" FROM wm_ticket t LEFT JOIN wm_equipment e ON e.id = t.equipment_id LEFT JOIN wm_shop s ON s.id = t.shop_id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC) t"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

reports.title: Цехи · план/факт
reports.query: SELECT code, name, plan_m3, fact_m3, CASE WHEN plan_m3 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((fact_m3 * 100.0 / plan_m3)::numeric, 1) END AS plan_pct, scrap_pct, waste_m3, downtime_min, energy_kwh_m3, status FROM wm_shop ORDER BY sort_order

reports.title: Оборудование
reports.query: SELECT e.code, e.name, s.code AS shop, e.eq_type, e.status, e.health_index, e.link_ok, e.bearing_temp_c, e.vibration_mms, e.current_a, e.tool_wear_pct, e.operator_name FROM wm_equipment e JOIN wm_shop s ON s.id = e.shop_id ORDER BY s.sort_order, e.code

reports.title: Ц-1 Распиловка
reports.query: SELECT code, name, status, feed_mpm, power_kw, current_a, bearing_temp_c, vibration_mms, tool_state, volume_m3, stop_count FROM wm_equipment WHERE shop_id = 'shop-1' ORDER BY code

reports.title: Сушильные камеры
reports.query: SELECT code, status, chamber_temp_c, air_humidity_pct, wood_moisture_pct, cycle_stage, cycle_eta_min, fan_ok, heater_ok, mode_deviation, health_index FROM wm_equipment WHERE eq_type = 'dryer' ORDER BY code

reports.title: Партии сушки
reports.query: SELECT b.batch_no, e.code AS chamber, b.species, b.thickness_mm, b.moisture_in_pct, b.moisture_out_pct, b.duration_h, b.max_temp_c, b.status, b.deviations FROM wm_drying_batch b JOIN wm_equipment e ON e.id = b.chamber_id ORDER BY b.started_at DESC

reports.title: Заявки ТОиР
reports.query: SELECT t.id, e.code AS equipment, t.title, t.severity, t.status, t.source, t.created_by, t.assignee, t.created_at FROM wm_ticket t LEFT JOIN wm_equipment e ON e.id = t.equipment_id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

reports.title: Состояние оборудования
reports.query: SELECT e.code, s.code AS shop, e.name, e.health_index, e.status, e.bearing_temp_c, e.vibration_mms, e.stop_count, e.tool_wear_pct, e.runtime_hours FROM wm_equipment e JOIN wm_shop s ON s.id = e.shop_id ORDER BY e.health_index ASC

reports.title: Качество
reports.query: SELECT batch_no, product_type, thickness_mm, thickness_dev_mm, moisture_pct, flatness_mm, status, decision, inspector, checked_at FROM wm_quality_check ORDER BY checked_at DESC

reports.title: Аварии / предупреждения
reports.query: SELECT a.severity, e.code AS equipment, a.title, a.param_key, a.param_value, a.status, a.created_at FROM wm_alarm a LEFT JOIN wm_equipment e ON e.id = a.equipment_id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

reports.title: ИИ-советник
reports.query: SELECT advice_type, context_ref, question, created_at FROM wm_ai_advice ORDER BY created_at DESC

reports.title: Журнал аудита
reports.query: SELECT created_at, actor, entity_type, entity_id, action, detail FROM wm_audit_log ORDER BY created_at DESC

reports.title: Сменный план
reports.query: SELECT s.code, p.product_name, p.plan_m3, p.fact_m3, CASE WHEN p.plan_m3 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((p.fact_m3 * 100.0 / p.plan_m3)::numeric, 1) END AS plan_pct, p.pieces, p.scrap_pct, p.status FROM wm_production_plan p JOIN wm_shop s ON s.id = p.shop_id ORDER BY s.sort_order

reports.title: Выпуск по часам
reports.query: SELECT label AS hour, value AS m3 FROM wm_kpi_point WHERE series = 'output_m3' ORDER BY sort_order

reports.title: Выполнение плана по цехам
reports.query: SELECT label AS shop, value AS plan_pct FROM wm_kpi_point WHERE series = 'plan_pct' ORDER BY sort_order

reports.title: Влажность древесины
reports.query: SELECT label AS t, value AS moisture_pct FROM wm_kpi_point WHERE series = 'moisture' ORDER BY sort_order
